podcast.title: David Bowie Collaboration (2007)
podcast.body: David Bowie introduced Ricky Gervais at a show at Madison Square Garden on May 19, 2007, and sang a song that Bowie had written specifically for Gervais's TV series, *Extras*. "He walked on stage ahead of a Ricky Juvet show at Madison Square Garden and introduced Ricky with a song he made up for Ricky's TV series, Extras."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Last Ever Performance (2007)
xref.body: Bowie's absolute last performance occurred on May 19, 2007, at Madison Square Garden. He appeared on stage before a Ricky Gervais show to introduce Gervais, performing a song he had created for Gervais's TV series, *Extras*. "David Bowie's last ever performance came on May 19th, 2007."

xref.title: Live 8 Performance - Philadelphia
xref.body: Coldplay was one of the many artists and celebrities who appeared at the Live 8 global telecast benefit concert on July 2nd, 2005. "You too, audio, life, green day, Roxy music, James Brown, Nelson Mandela, Bill Gates, Brad Pitt, David Beckham, Ricky Gervais, Coldplay, Madonna, REM, the killer, Sting, the cure, Lincoln Park, Sarah McLaughlin, Will Smith, and Durand Durand, and a whole bunch of others."

xref.title: Managed by Ricky Gervais
xref.body: The Britpop band Suede was, for a brief period, managed by comedian Ricky Gervais. "And comedian Ricky Gervais was for a very brief time the manager of the Britpop band, Swade."
